notes: The minifigure on pages 5/48 is not in the supplied parts list, so it is not recorded; the 150 listed pieces are all recorded (b1-b150) and each type matches the count in the list.

Connectivity fix: the two spare coins b33/b34 were isolated (the booklet only shows them lying beside the coin box in step 11, 2 of the 4 coins go inside). They are now linked to the box b29 with a loose 'touching/kept with' join so the model is one connected build; they are not physically fastened.
The rocket (b80+) is joined to the base/mechanism only through the mechanism axle b50 entering the axle hole of round plate b93 (step 42), so the whole set is a single model.

Several sub-assemblies are built separately, upside-down or sideways (crank, front star panel b54-b73, the rocket hull b80+ which is built inverted then flipped at step 31). For these, rests_on names the earlier piece that is clutched at that moment, so every rests_on points to a lower-numbered id.

Pieces that attach sideways or are not clutched from beneath (side-stud round plates b128-b139, cones b114/b115, flags, pins, bushes, hubs, coins, door) have rests_on [] and are described in other_joins.

The tile/curved-brick contacts at the top deck (b74-b78), the stack of plates under each curved 2x4 (b36-b41) and exactly which bricks sit under which in the lower base layers are best-effort readings of the isometric drawings; positions are null.
